title: Transport the completed diagonal diagram to condensed coefficients
statement: In the setting of [lem-diagonal-completed-frame], let delta be a completed diagonal arrow and tq,t1,t2 the three completed traces in the prescribed projective models. Assume normalized sources a1,a2 satisfy a_i R_i(delta) trace_i=id. There exists a condensed Z_ell Diagram d as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], such that every Family whose Z_ell component equals d admits a Reference for the specified whole completed arrow delta and traces as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. No integral extension, rationalization or quotient assertion is made.

source.place: paragraph (1), transport of the class and traces

proof.text: Obtain the completed coefficient frame. Conjugate delta by the source, single and shifted-line comparisons. Define each trace by the inverse direct-image/shifted-line comparison followed by the image of its completed trace and the regular-module comparison.

The class square follows by cancellation of the source isomorphism. Each trace square follows by cancelling its defining inverse. Use integration_transport for each projection with the frame source square and these class and trace squares. Assemble Diagram and Reference; the canonical derived models have their literal functor equalities and units.

theorem diagonalCompletedDiagram_realization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (tq : DiagonalTrace.Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (t₁ : DiagonalTrace.Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l))
      (pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (t₂ : DiagonalTrace.Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l))
      (pullback.snd (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (hq : tq.model.model = Iso.refl (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (h₁ : t₁.model.model = diagonalTraceFirstModel Y)
    (h₂ : t₂.model.model = diagonalTraceSecondModel Y)
    (a₁ : DiagonalTrace.SupportedSource l Y
      (pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) t₁.Rc)
    (a₂ : DiagonalTrace.SupportedSource l Y
      (pullback.snd (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) t₂.Rc)
    (hi₁ : DiagonalTrace.IsIntegration t₁.Rc.R a₁.hom t₁.trace δ)
    (hi₂ : DiagonalTrace.IsIntegration t₂.Rc.R a₂.hom t₂.trace δ) :
    ∃ d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y (zlLine l),
      ∀ family : Family l Y, family.zl = d → Nonempty (Reference l Y δ family)
